degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Breif Introduction The MSc (Communications Engineering) is designed for aspiring engineers and information technologists who wish to improve their knowledge and skills in the broad area of communications engineering. The courses offered cover various important topics in telecommunications, RF engineering and wireless communications Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

duration.text: The Communication Engineering at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
